case study for pinnacles national park (PINN)

```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, dplyr, modelsummary, gt, fixest)

df <- read_csv('../../data/total.csv')

# USING MONTHLY VISITATION DATA
pinn_month_df <- read_csv('../../data/visitation/PINN.csv')
```


```{r}
ggplot(pinn_month_df,
       aes(x = Year, y = log(Year_vis))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 2013,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pinnacles National Park Visitation",
    subtitle = "Dashed line indicates the 2013 Tribal–NPS MOU",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Log annual visitation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

library(tidyr)

months <- c(
  "JAN", "FEB", "MAR", "APR", "MAY", "JUN",
  "JUL", "AUG", "SEP", "OCT", "NOV", "DEC"
)

pinn_month_long <- pinn_month_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(months),
    names_to = "month",
    values_to = "visitation"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = months),
    month_number = match(month, months),
    date = as.Date(
      paste(Year, month_number, "01", sep = "-")
    )
  )


```

```{r}
ggplot(pinn_month_long,
       aes(x = date, y = log(visitation))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2013-04-27"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Visitation at Pinnacles",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Monthly visitation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
